facts.fact: Arnold Palmer, 2002; redesigned by Gil Hanse with Brad Faxon, 2007. Host of the Deutsche Bank Championship (2003-2016).
Ponds and marshes run through the middle of the course.

current.subject: A baby-blue pair of lederhosen (developer's pick).
current.keep: The joke and the baby blue.
current.weaknesses: Plain shapes; the details that make lederhosen lederhosen are missing.

concepts.name: Lederhosen, Sunday Best
concepts.rationale: Proper Bavarian lederhosen: H-bar braces with an edelweiss on the chest bar, an embroidered front flap, horn buttons.
concepts.symbolism: A wink at the course's German-bank tournament years.
concepts.interpretation: The Deutsche Bank link is our reading of the developer's joke.
concepts.tradeoffs: An in-joke; nothing to do with golf or Massachusetts.

concepts.name: The Cattails
concepts.rationale: Three cattails in marsh water: the wetlands that thread through the course.
concepts.strengths: Clean, natural, clear of TPC marks.

recommendation: Concept 1, because the developer chose the joke. The cattails are the sensible choice if the course should look like itself.
